display.purpose: Page H1s and the CTA band headline.

title.purpose: Product names, steps, FAQ questions, fact titles.

lede.purpose: Intro paragraph under H1 and section heads.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All transitions and the entrance reveal.

motion.name: reveal-img
motion.purpose: Hero photograph entrance, once per page; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Every action: request a proposal, order, send.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Solicitar propuesta <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.5rem; min-height:48px; padding:12px 24px; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:#2F7A4E; color:#fff; font:700 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#24613D; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F7A4E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height:48px; padding:12px 24px; border:1.5px solid #14342B; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#14342B; font:700 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 180ms, color 180ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#14342B; color:#fff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F7A4E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.4rem; font:600 .875rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; color:#14342B; } .ds-input { min-height:48px; padding:11px 16px; border:1.5px solid #CFC9BA; border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:#14342B; font:400 1rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#6E7D75; } .ds-input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#2F7A4E; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #E6F0E7; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; padding:5px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(20,52,43,.07); color:#14342B; font:600 .8125rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; }

components.name: Line Tile
components.description: Link to a product line on its food field.
components.html: Plant-Based
components.css: .ds-line-tile { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:1rem; padding:18px 20px; border-radius:14px; background:#D5E5C7; color:#14342B; text-decoration:none; font:700 1.1875rem 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.015em; } .ds-line-tile svg { transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-line-tile:hover svg { transform:translate(2px,-2px); } .ds-line-tile:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #2F7A4E; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Header links with line-colour dots and a pill for the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:.25rem; font:600 .9375rem 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.45rem; padding:8px 13px; border-radius:999px; color:#4A5D54; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:#14342B; background:#F5F2EA; } .ds-nav i { width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; }

narrative.northStar: The produce aisle, set by a careful hand
narrative.overview: The category standard for a healthy-food supplier executed at Oatly / Rude Health craft: product photography on food-coloured fields, a confident grotesque for headings, white and oat grounds, and the proposal request always one step away. Built for trade buyers.
keyCharacteristics: One food field per product line

rules.name: One line, one field
rules.body: Each product line owns one food tint and nothing else uses it.

rules.name: Green means go
rules.body: Leaf green appears only on actions and focus.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: No card shadows; depth comes from grounds and hairlines.

dos: Do keep a proposal action visible on every page.
Do label placeholder statistics until they are real.
donts: Don't add eyebrow labels, gradient text or emoji icons.
Don't repeat one photo across a product grid.
